response.sql:
WITH qualifying_lines AS (
    SELECT category, remaining, amount, spent
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount >= 75
),
category_stats AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining_amount,
        SUM(amount - spent) AS total
    FROM qualifying_lines
    GROUP BY category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total
    FROM category_stats
)
SELECT
    cs.category,
    cs.average_remaining_amount,
    cs.total,
    cs.total - oa.average_total AS total_minus_overall_average
FROM category_stats AS cs
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE oa.average_total IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.total > oa.average_total;

assumptions.assumption: “Threshold of 75” means budgeted amount is at least 75 dollars; a budget line with amount exactly 75 qualifies.

alternatives.interpretation: If the threshold means strictly more than 75 dollars, exclude lines with amount exactly 75.
